subject.title: feat(slack): support Enterprise Grid org installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this bundled Slack Enterprise Grid V1 now, including enterpriseOrgInstall plus the two new adapter hooks, once live org-install proof is added?
rationale: The code direction is plausible, but deciding whether these config/plugin API surfaces and intentional fail-closed enterprise limitations belong in core/bundled Slack requires maintainer product and compatibility intent.

options.title: Approve V1 after proof
options.body: Require a redacted live Enterprise Grid Socket Mode or HTTP message/reply smoke plus maintainer approval of the config and adapter hooks before merge.

options.title: Accept opt-in risk now
options.body: Merge the opt-in V1 with documented limitations and handle live-only Enterprise Grid issues as follow-up work.

options.title: Hold or narrow
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want durable workspace authorization or an external/plugin-only path before adding core adapter hooks.

recommendation.title: Approve V1 after proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted live Enterprise Grid Socket Mode or HTTP message/reply smoke plus maintainer approval of the config and adapter hooks before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across Slack runtime, outbound delivery, and plugin-boundary decisions relevant to this product/API choice.
